system.story: The mender and deep-communion specialist - the tech-side medic.

description.value:
Subclass: Machine-Whisperer - the Healer/Interface. The mender and deep-communion specialist: the tech-side medic and the one who Jumps-In gearlessly.

Role Feature - Laying On of Code

Your Resonance Mending restores more and works at range freely, and your Deep Communion costs less and grants a larger buffer; you are the premier healer of machines, drones, chrome, and Cyborgs.

Signature Tweak

Resonance Mending can mend two targets at once, or split a heal into a heal-over-time.

Bonus Skill & Contact

Mechanics / medtech, plus a street-doc, rigger, or Cyborg-clinic contact.

Chrome Flavor

The most chrome-tolerant of the three - a resonance-tuned datajack that deepens communion without breaking the half-caster fence.
